rejected_rule.statement: A decision of the Board of Review on an appeal under section 70 of the Income Tax Ordinance is not res judicata in respect to a matter to be decided under section 34 of the Estate Duty Ordinance.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "With regard to this case I would observe that it was a decision of the Full Court of Australia that caused estoppel by reason of res judicata. In the present case we are asked to say that a decision of the Board of Review on an appeal under section 70 of the Income Tax Ordinance (Cap. 188) is res judicata in respect to a matter to be decided under section 34 of .the Estate Duty Ordinance (Cap. 197). I cannot regard Hoystead v. Commissioner of Taxation as supporting this contention."

meta.parties: The Attorney General v. Valliyamma Atchie
